tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor ba kun grol zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams kun la rang rig ye shes mchog /ris bral 'od brgyas rnam par snang mdzad pa/ bla med bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gus pas btud nas dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /tshul 'di shin tu dar bas na/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga yi ge mtha' yas snang*/ /'on kyang mang pos nan tan du/ /bskul phyir 'bri ba'ang mi 'gal tsam/ de la re zhig dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten nas myur du sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi/ cho ga nyin gcig ma bshad par bya'o/ /thog mar yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ cho ga la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po gnas kyi bdag po la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi las rgya bcings pas so/ / hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas so/ / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ar+ya nut+pan+na twata/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul lo/ /sngags de dag kyang lan gsum gsum mo/ / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥn ma ཿsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pas bsngos/ phyag rgya ni rdor thal kha phye ba'o/ / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhu pe ā lo ke gan+d+ye ne we te badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dril bsil dang bcas/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*/ /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/

ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor na/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ ces rol mo dang bcas gtor ma phyi rol tu dor/ gnyis pa gnas dang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar rol chen dang bcas te/ na mo b+ta ga wa te badz+ra sa ra pra ma dha na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+ta u pa saṃ kra ma ṇe/ /sarba karma a ba ra ṇa/ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ lan gsum mo/ /gsum pa rgyud dag par byed pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyis bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la phyag skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / lan mang du brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dngaldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi lan gsum/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ / brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas/ / rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ / lan gsum mo/ /bzhi pa nang khrus ni/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhāṃ wa shud+dho3haṃ/ snang grags gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub cing*/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'gyur ba med pa'o/ / gnyis pa khyad par kyi sngon 'gro la gsum las/ dang po lce lag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad lce'i thad ka'i pad 'dab du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ rdo rje de lce la thim pas lce rdo rje rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa lan gsum/ lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re re'o/

/de zhu ba las rdo rje lag pa sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig pa rnams su gyur/ gnyis pa srung 'khor la/ / lhar bskyed dbang bskur go cha bgo /spyan 'dren mchod bstod bka' bsgo dang*/ bsnun sogs phyogs bcing bsrung dang brtan/ zhes pa ltar don bcu las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng hūṃ/ de'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje zhi ba nyid yongs su gyur te/ rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa thugs kar gsor zhing*/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ shin tu 'jigs khrod 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ / rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing ma rungs pa rnams sdigs par mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ khro bo ti rin+ti ri'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sa mā ya hūṃ baṃ/ phyag rgya de nyi spyi bo la sogs pa rigs bdag gi gnas lngar reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ lan lngas 'phreng bas dbang bskur/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyor gnas dgur reg cing*/ mdud pa bcing tshul dang bcas/ oṃ ṭ+ruṃ lan dgu /g.yas pa'i mthe chung dang*/ g.yon pa'i mdzum mo nas bkrol te/ thal mo'i rting pa brdabs la/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes pa rnams kyis go bgo'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ de nas dril sil dang bcas te/ hūṃ ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhā rā dza sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lnga pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ ne wi ta ེ'i bar du sbyar/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten sprod pa'i tshal yang mi spong zhing*/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*/ /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyi brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig pa'i huṃ sgra des sgrog cing*/ / bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ / bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ drug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig/nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ khyed cag 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*/ /gegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ dril sil rol chen dang bcas te/ hūṃ bzhi pa bzlas so/ /bdun pa ni/ bgegs la bsnun pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ/

me'i phyag rgya dang*/ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sogs bcings pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ badz+ra ne ti ban+dha sarba bigh+nān/ de gsum ni sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba'o/ / brgyad pa ni/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi bho me bha wa rak+ṣa sarba na swāhā/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ steng rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla brer gyur/ oṃ truṃ ban+dha haṃ/ shar tu rdo rje'i rwa ba grub/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra pā sha hrā ཿ de'i nang du rwa ba gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ gi pa taṃ gi ni ra ṭa/ nub tu rdo rje rwa ba grub/ hrīḥbadz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ byang du rdo rje'i rwa ba grub/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa/ lhor rdo rje'i rwa ba grub/ hūṃ badz+ra karma phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ de'i nang du yang rdo rje'i rwa bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ/ phyi rol du yang rdo rje'i rang bzhin dum bu gcig par gyur/ bgegs la bsnun pa nas bzung*/ hūṃ rkyang ma gtogs pa'i sngags de rnams lan gsum bya/ dgu pa ni/ khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na larkā mahā badz+ra kro dha tra ba tra ba bi tra ba/ bi tra ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ prā ṇāṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan dgu / o badz+ra kārma kaṃ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ/ de rnams kyang lan gsum gsum ste/ srung ba yin no/ bcu pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu rgyun 'khrol dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ṭi d+dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ /sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me/ tsut+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/

badz+ra satwa mā me muñtsa badz+ri bha wa maha sa mā ya swatwa a/ zhes lan gsum gyi brtan par mos so/ /ti rin+ti ri'i phyag rgya man chad nas de yan chad la badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs sngags lan dgu brjod rgyu de ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad logs nas drangs pa'o/ / gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya g.yas su bskor/ dkyil 'khor lo grub/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lbā' ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me na/ badz+ra ban+dha naṃ/ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag byas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ nas/ shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis bstod/ rgyun bshags ni/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang*/ /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags/ /bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*/ /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang*/ /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cig /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang zhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pas 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing*/ /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje che ldan pa/ / brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*/ /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes su bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs//

mnyam med byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram/ /rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir/ 'di dag thams cad rtsa sogs bzhin du btang*/ /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ khyad 'phags gnas la bdag gis gnas par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ zhes bya/ de yan chad kyi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams bstan zin to/ / da ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa la bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ /mdun skyed/ mchod gtor/ bdag 'jug ste lnga las/ dang po la lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog

/las rgyal mchog ste gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ stong nyid rten bskyed gtso bor sgom/ /gzug brnyan sbyor dang sdig pa bral/ /ye shes phab nas dbang du bya/ /gnas gsum byin brlabs dbang bskur dang*/ /mchod bstod 'phrin las bcu gcig go/de nas dang po ni/ oṃ shu+u n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bh+rā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ bha stong pa'i ngang las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du gser kyi sa gzhi/ de'i steng du rgya mtsho chen po/ dbus su ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa shar shel lho baiḍūr+ya nub pad+ma ra ga byang gser las grub pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ljang dmar ser sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i gzhi dang*/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis skor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ them skas dang bcas pa'i sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi glang seng brtsegs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ de'i steng du gdugs dang g.yas g.yon tu ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ 'khyams gyi phyi rol du rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang de'i nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/

phyi'i 'khyams ri rab kyi phyogs dang mtshungs pa'i mdog dang*/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang pa gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gzhi dkar ba/ de'i dbus su seng ge shar du glang po lho rta mchog nub tu rma bya byang du mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri re re/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhugs khri lnga'i steng dang*/ /mtshams bzhi po rnams dang*/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang*/ /gru chad bzhi dang/ sgo bzhi dang*/ grwa bzhi rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ / gsum pa ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ / sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu zhi ba chen po'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis brtan par bzhugs pa/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs rin po che'i cod pan can/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po'i cha byad can 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ gzugs brnyan sbyor ba ste/ lag gnyis thal mo gan rkyal byas/ lag pa gnyis su oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du g.yas par hūṃ/ g.yon par āḥganyis ka'i mtha' skor du/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥrnams kyis yongs su bskor ba 'od 'phro ba'o/ /mthe bong gnyis la oṃ/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūṃ/

gung mo gnyis la traṃ/ srin las gnyis la hriḥ mthe chungaganyis la a/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la rnam snang mi skyod pa rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams so/ /g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje thams cad ma rnams 'khod par gyur/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ lha dang lha mo phan tshun reg par 'gyur/ rdo rje thal mo dang*/ pa ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmāḥ rjes su zhugs par gyur/ rdo rje bsdam pa dang*/ at+yat+ta a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharmāḥbadz+ra ban+dha/ lha rnams ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ lnga pa ni/ rdor bsdams dral/ badz+ra ban+dha tra ṭa lan gsum/ sdig pa thams cad bral bar gyur/ drug pa ni/ rdor bsdams mthe bong nang du bcug dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin babs te snying gar thim/ badz+ra ā be sha zhes pa lan gcig dang*/ a zhes pa nyer gcig phyag rgya de nyid dkrol la ser gol gtogs/ tiṣ+ta badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūṃ brtan par gyur/ bdun pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam rgya dang*/ badz+ra muṣ+ti/ de bkrol la sel gol gtogs/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+tibaṃ/ lan gsum thams cad dbangadu gyur/ brgyad pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs la/ oṃ bhṛ ta bhṛ ta sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ trā ṭa tra ṭa sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ dgu pa ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ raṇ+ṇa a bhi ṣiṣ+tsa traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ bcu pa ni/ bar 'dir sbro na/

tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bya la/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyi mchod de/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe a hūṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyi mchod cing chog go /bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo mas bstod/ sdig pa dral ba nas mchod bstod kyi bar 'di dang po sbyor ba la nges par dgos pas yan lag yin zhing*/ gzugs brnyan sbyor ba dngos ni/ spyir na dang po sbyor ba'i yan lag tu nges par dgos pa ma yin pas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gtab kyi sngon du byas kyang chog mod kyi/ sdig pa dral ba sogs kyi sngon du byed pa spyi khyab kyi lag len la 'dug pa ltar 'gal ba yang mi snang bas re shig skabs 'dir bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ de nas 'di skad ces ngag tu brjod cing don bsam ste/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la gzhugs te/ de nas ngan song gi rgyud yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byangachub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa mang po'i 'phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'chings pa las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas/ yang dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mchod nas lan brgya stong du bskor ba byas te/ mgo bos lan brgya stong du phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod cing rnam pa du mas mchod nas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur to

zhes so/ / tshig 'di ni rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang bar ma chad par gleng slang ba'i skabs yin pas/ 'di skabs kyi tshangs pa chen po ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid yin na/ rdor sems dang phyag rdor sogs la sbyor ba cung zad mi rigs pas kun rig gi dkyil 'khor la ni/ shākya thub nyid sku'i rnam pa 'gyur ba'i rnam snang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pas rnam snang la sbyong ba dang*/ gtsug dgu lta bu la ni sku'i rnam pa ma 'gyur ba'i shākya seng ge la'ang sbyar bas legs so/ /yang dkyil 'khor 'di la shākya rigs kyi dbang po ni/ sku rnam pa ma 'gyur ba'i shākya thub nyid yin kyang*/ gtso bo las gzhan du sku'i rnam pa logs su bstan pa nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ma yin pa'i phyir gleng gzhi dang gleng slang gi 'phrin las kyi gtso bo mdzad pa'i dogs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po zhes pa bcom ldan 'das thub pa nyid rnam par snang mdzad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad du bzhengs pa nyid yin par the tshom med pas/ rigs kyi cal col mang po'i rjes su 'brang bar mi bya'o/ /spyir rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang mthun par 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgom pa ni shin tu legs la/ tshig 'di nyid kho na brjod dgos par ni ma nges te/ tshig 'di rgyud las 'byung yang lo rgyus kyi skabs tsam yin gyi/ cho ga'i don du gsungs pa'i sngags tshig ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang tshig tu brjod phyin rgyud tshig brjod na shin tu bzang zhing*/ phyogs 'di'i snga phyi thams cad kyang*/ dmigs pa 'di bsgom phyin tshig 'di yang brjod pa'i lag len du mthun par snang ngo*/ /de ltar na de dag gis ni dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ /sa bon spro dang 'khor tshogs bskyed/ /ye shes spyan 'dren mdzad pa dang*/ /rgyan gdab sngon 'gro rgyas btab dngos/

/dbang bskur zhes te don tshan bdun/ dang po ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ trāṃ hriḥ.a/ oṃ trāṃ hriḥ.a/ hūṃ dza ho dhu/ traṃ r+ya bhi ta/ hriḥdhiḥkruṃ bhā/ kaṃ raṃ k+ṣaṃ saṃ/ hūṃ trāṃ hri a/ hūṃ trāṃ hri a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnams su gyur/ de rnams gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas phyir spros te so so'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ yig 'bru de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad/ slar 'dus te so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir sbyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi/ mtshams bzhir yum bzhi/ rtsibs bcu drug la byang shar mtshams kyi tshur rol nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor gyi sems dpa' bcu drug ste/ phyogs bzhi so sor rtsibs bzhi bzhi la sems dpa' bzhi bzhi/ gru chad bzhi la sgeg mo sogs bzhi/ lha snam kyi grwa bzhi la me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi/ sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi rnams grub pa ni/ hūṃ las dbus kyi shar du thams cad rig pa sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ trāṃ las lhor thams cad rig pa rgyal ba mchog sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ hrīḥlas nub tu thams cad rig pa shākya thub pa ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sha las byang du thams cad rig pa rin chen me tog ljang khu/ g.yas skyabs spyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi po de rnams kyang rang rang gi khri la bzhugs shing*/ gtso bo dang mtshungs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs can no/ /shar lhor oṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo spyan 'bras kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu trāṃ las mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/

nub byang du pāṃ las gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ de rnams phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug la byang shar mtshams nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis sems dpa' bcu drug tu gyur pa las/ shar phyogs su bzhi ni hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dzaḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang khu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster pa/ lho'i phyogs su bzhi ni/ trāṃ las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ bh+ri las rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog can gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i 'phrengab 'dzin pa/ nub phyogs su bzhi ni/ hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ g.yon pad+ma'i sdong po rtsa ba dkur brten zhing*/ /g.yas pas de'i me tog thugs ka'i thad du kha 'byed pa/ dhīḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ kruṃ las rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bskor ba/ bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ljags 'dzin pa/ /byang phyogs su bzhi ni/ kaṃ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zheng*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ raṃ las rdo rje srung ba ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje'i go khrab 'dzin pa/ k+ṣaṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje mche ba re re 'dzin pa/

saṃ las rdo rje khu tshur ser po phyag gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol zur mtshams bzhi la shar lhor hūṃ las rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje re re bzung nas snyems pa'i tshul 'dzad pa/ lho nub tu traṃ las rdo rje 'phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hriḥlas rdo rje glu ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ /byang shar tu a las rdo rje gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol mtshams bzhi la shar lhor hūṃ las gdug spos ma dkar mo spos snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu trāṃ las me tog ma ser mo me tog gi kong bu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hriḥlas mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du a las dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol du sgo ma bzhi po dag ni/ shar du dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor hūṃ las rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo phyag gnyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu baṃ las rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo phyag gnyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang du hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu phyag g.yas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum bzhi dang*/ lho dang nub kyis sems dpa' lhag ma gsum gsum dang*/ dril bu ma rnams g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sems dpa' thams cad ral pa'i thod tshugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha mo rnams ni dbu skra byed bcings pa/ sked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/

/ 'di dag las kha cig sgo skyong bzhi khro bo khro mor 'dod de 'dir de ltar mi byed la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo sbom thung stag lpags sbrul rgyan can du 'dod pa dang*/ zhi ma khro dar dngarin po ches brgyan par 'dod pa la sogs yod kyang*/ 'dir ni sems dpa' bcu drug bzhi khro'i nyams dang cha lugs la khyad par med par byas na legs so/ / dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi khyams la byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams/ khro bo mngags pa pho nya sogs/ /dkyil 'khor phyi yi phyi rol du/ / 'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa dang*/ /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug che/ /shar dang nub kyi gling du ni/ /brgya byin khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas/ /lha min dri za nam mkha' lding*/ /gnod sbyin srin po lto phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*/ /klu dang grul bum ri rnams dang*/ /rgyal po bzhi rnams gnas par gyur/ /gza' dngaskar ma rgyu skar dang*/ khros pa ma rungs 'tshe ba ni/ /bgegs dang bi nā ya ka dang*/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /drang srong skal pa chen po rnams/ /phra men ma dang bud med dang*/ /sring mo de bzhin rnal 'byor ma/ /'byung ba bzhi yi lha chen po/ khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang*/ /shing dang kun ra nags la sogs/ / dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa'o/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' 'khor du gnas pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de dag ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza dang rdo rje bsdu pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun nas sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon par gyur/

bzhi pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes dam tshig pa la phyag mdzad par bsam/ e ma ho kun tu bzang po yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ zhes ched du brjod nas/ 'khor thams cad phyogs phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kar 'dus lnga po yang dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thugs kar zhugs te gnas pa las ji ltar thim pa bzhin du rgyal ba lnga spros/ gzhan rnams lnga po rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros te/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnams la ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du so sor gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dza/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha a/ e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba med/ /rdul phran rnams ni ji snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ zhes ched du brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ las rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ gsum/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dam rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ gsum/ sgo bcad/ las rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ gsum go bskon/ oṃ kruṃ/ dgu oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes pas srung ba byas/ rdor thal kha phye/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ gis mchod yon phul/ de rnams rgyas btab kyi sngon 'gro yin no/ /drug pa rgyas btab dngos la bzhi las/ dang por dam tshig gi phyag rgyas btab pa ni/ dri ṣ+ti ma ṭa/ sa ma ya stāṃ/ sarba bid tri sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid sarba bid sarba bid/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gtso bo rnam snang gi'o/ /de bzhin du/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sarba bid tṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid sarba bid sarba bid ces pa'i mthar oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/

lan gsum/ spyong rgyal gyi'o/ /sangs rgyas gzhan gsum la'ang des rigs 'gre ste/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid a/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ ces mtha'i sngags sgyur ba kho na'o/ /de dag ni dbus kyi gshegs pa lnga'o/ / su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ bud+dha lo tsa nī tṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ bud+dha lo tsa nī bud+dha lo tsa nī bud+dha lo tsa nī zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa nī oṃ/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i 'o/ /'di man chad des rigs 'gre ste/ bud+dha lo tsa ni zhes pa'i dod du/ badz+ra mā ma kī mtha'i sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī traṃ/ de bzhin du badz+ra pan+ṭa rwa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pan+ṭa ra de hi sid+dhi lo kot+ta raṃ baṃ swāhā/ badz+ra tā re dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swa swa swa swā hā/ yum bzhi'o/ /sems dpa' bcu drug po rnams la badz+ra satwa kho na las gzhan so so'i mtshan mi dgos/ phyag rgya dang mtha' bsten gyi sa bon bsgyur ba kho nas chog ste/ su ra ta s+t+wam badz+ra satwa dri sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ badz+ra satwa badz+ra satwa badz+ra satwa oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje sems dpa' la te gzhan rnams la mtha'i huṃ gi tshab tu/ oṃ badz+ra satwa dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hoḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa dhu/ oṃ badz+ra satwa traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ya/ oṃ badz+ra satwa bh+ri/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ha/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hriḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa kruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa bha/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kaṃ /oṃ badz+ra satwa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa k+ṣaṃ/ zhes te mthar su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra satwa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+wam sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ badz+ra satwa badz+ra satwa/ badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa saṃ/ zhes pa rdo rje khu tshur gyi bar du'o/ /de bzhin du/ badz+ra la s+ya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ badz+ra mā le dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ badz+ra gi ti dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hriḥ badz+ra nāṃ t+ya dang*/

oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yi a/ badz+ra dhu pe dang*/ o badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra gan+dhe dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe a/ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /badz+ra spo ṭa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ sgo ba bzhi po rnams kyi'o/ /skal bzang bcu drug man chad la ni bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'dir rgyas btab mi dgos te mos sgom kho na las/ gzhan bskyed chog gis bskyed pa med pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bsgrubs pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ las dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res mtshan par gyur/ gnyis pa chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lce'i pad+ma'i 'dab mar hrīḥlas zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje'i lte ba la lha rang rang gi gsang sngags chos kyi yi ges mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ho 'i bar lan re'am/ tshar gsum gsum skabs dang 'tshams par brjod 'di la lag pa'i phyag rgya phyag chen dang 'dra bar 'ching ba'i srol yang 'dug mod kyi/ chos rgya la lag pa'i phyag rgya mi 'ching ba nyid gdod ma'i lugs 。。so/ /gsum pa las kyi phyag rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar a las sna tshogs rdo rje re res mtshan par gyur/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud na gsal ba rnams de dang de yin la/ mi gsal ba rnams phyag mtshan med pa'i phyag chen gyi tshul du 'ching ba yin no/ /gong dam rgya'i skabs su bshad pa ltar rigs lnga las/ sa ma ya stāṃ dang*/ gzhan rnams la su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ mgor sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba a pa ya bi sho dha ni hū ཾ phaṭa/ sarba bid

ces pa lngas rigs lnga dang*/ oṃ sarba ā pa ya bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ bud+dha lo tsi ni zhes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ā pa ya bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ā be sha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ha ོ'i bar sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dang*/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ gyi mgo 'dren tshul gong bzhin te/ ji ltar bsgom pa dang mthun pa'i phyag chen bcing ngo*/ /gal te phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs mi lcogs na/ sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs pa tsam byed pa yin mod kyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i lugs byed phyin nges par bya ste/ 'di med na de nyid bsdus pa sogs nas khyad chos gzhan ni de bas med pas yo ga'i cho ga yin rgyu ci yang med do/ /sbyong rgyud yo ga kho nar 'dod bzhin du rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab mi 'dod pa ni shin tu 'gal ba chen po yin la/ spyir nas sbyong rgyud kyi cho ga la dam rgya dang las 'chol ba'i phyag rgya ni nges par dgos shing*/ gzhan rnams med kyang chog pa'i skabs srid de/ de'i tshe sbyong rgyud kyang yo ga'i rgyud kho nar mi 'dod de gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /yo ga dang mthun pa'i lugs byed na ni/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa bsgoms nas chos shin tu bsdu na yang de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la rgya bzhis gdab pa med na/ cho ga'i yan lag chad pa'i nyes pa che bar 'gyur nges so/ /bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ gong bzhin rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs te/ lha thams cad la rgyas btab pa ra bsam/ 'dir bsdus pa'i lugs yin pas dbang bskur de tsam gyis chog go /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la las bcol dang*/ mchod brtod gnyis las/

dang po ni/ so so'i dam rgya 'ching bzhin du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can thams cad ngan song las grol bar mdzad cing*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral te/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du sde tshan so so'i mgor/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig tshar re dang*/ gzhug tu las bcol re sbyar te sde tshan sde tshan du las bcol ba lag len yin pas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ na mo sogs/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ spyod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥshākya rigs dbang dang*/ o sarba bid tra ṭa me tog cher rgyas te/ phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis kyang sems can thams cad ngan song las grol bar mdzad cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral te myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oṃ lo tsa na sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ oṃ mā ma sogs mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ pan+ṭa rā sogs gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ tā re sogs sgrol ma ste yum bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa dzaḥrdo rje rgyal po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hoḥ rdo rje chags pa dang/ oṃ badz+ra satwa dhu rdo rje legs pa ste rdo rje'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa trāṃ/ rdo rje rin chen dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa bh+ri rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ha rdo rje bzhad pa ste rin chen rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang = sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hrīḥ rdo rje chos dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa dhi ཿrdo rje rnon po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kruṃ rdo rje rgyud dang*/

oṃ badz+ra satwa bha rdo rje smra ba ste pad+ma'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kaṃ /rdo rje las dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa raṃ rdo rje srung ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa k+ṣaṃ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa saṃ rdo rje khu tshur te las kyi rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ rdo rje sgeg mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥrdo rje glu ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ ti a rdo rje gar ma ste kru chad kyi lha mo bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ rdo rje bdug pa ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ rdo rje me tog ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke hri rdo rje mar me ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe a rdo rje dri chab ma ste grwa bzhi'i lha mo bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥrdo rje lcags kyu ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūṃ rdo rje zhags pa ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥrdo rje 'bebs pa ma ste sgo ma bzhis kyang sogs/ zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon phal cher sogs kyi tshigs bcad la/ bdag nyid chen po dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ ces sbyar te/ mchod yon dang me tog nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha ta/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ oṃ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nu ra ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ rdo rje chos ni glu blangs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hriḥ oṃ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra karma ka ro da bha we/ oṃ badz+ra ni ti a/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa'/ oṃ badz+ra satwa= oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ rdo rje rin chen= oṃ badz+ra rat+na=

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ rdo rje chos ni= badz+ra dharma= oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke trīḥ oṃ rdo rje las kun= badz+ra karma= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe a/ zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog/rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba// rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ /rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ /che ba'i che ba rgya mtsho che/ /rdo rje pad+ma byang chub che/ /byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /rdo rje rgya chen rgya che ste/ /rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje pad+ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa srung ba che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed/ /rdo rje ro langs ro langs che/ /rdo rje srin po za ba po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gdon de gdon gyi bdag

/'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa/ /sgrub dka' sgrub pa legs pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyes mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ /rdo rje gzi brjid gzi brjid che/ /'bar 'od gshin rje mthar byed pa/ /rdo rje drag po drag po che/ /'od sdug pas ni sdug pa che/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che//rigs sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ha la ha la nag po che/ /dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba/ skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom bcod/ /glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ /rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul/ /drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa/ /nyi ma stong gis gdung ba'i zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ /phyag rnams du ma'i mtshon cha brgya/ /dus ma'i zhal te sku yang stong*/ / 'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyol ba ste/ /sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang dri mthar mdzad/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba// zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs byed/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems/ /kun tu bzang po cher bzang po/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rab brgyan pa/ khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag nyid gtsang*/ zhes mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod/ 'di ni dngos su phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa yin la/ de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun 'dus pa'i don gyi bstod pa yin pas dkyil 'khor kun gyi bstod par 'gyur ba kho na'o/

/gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ bzlas pa mchod bstod nyer bsdu'o/ /dang po bzlas pa ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la rang sngags dang rtsa rig bkod/ snga ma rnams mi bzhed kyang dbus su rang rang gi sa bon bkod na legs so/ /lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs ka'i sngags 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ slar 'dus chos kyi yi ge so so la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durgati/ pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ /sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swāhā/ zhes pa nyid gtso bo rnam snang gi sngags yin yang lha thams cad kyi spyi sngags su 'gyur ro/ / oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa ni snying po ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kho na'i'o/ / rtsa rig dang snying po de nyid gang mos pa zhig ci nus su bzla zhing*/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ho 'i bar gong du bstan pa'i 'khor gyi sngags rnams kyang bdud la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa re bzla'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa sngags tsam gyi mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig ces bstod/ gsum pa nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis tshur drangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim/ zhes pa'o/ /bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rgyas par bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa bum bskyed ni/ cho ga nyin gcig pa'i phyogs la/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes su byas na legs mod kyis/

skabs 'dir byas na'ang 'gal ba med la/ de phyin chad gong ma'i lag len rgyun bzhin 'dir bya ste/ dbang bum lnga/ rnal rgyal bum pa gcig mchod bum bcu drug sogs ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ bsdu na rnam rgyal bum pa/ dbang bum/ mchod bum ste gsum bsham mo/ /shin tu bsdu na rnam rgyal gcig pus kyang chog par 'dod la/ las bum bshams na yang 'gal ba med mod kyi/ rgyud las gsal bar ma gsungs pas bsdu na med kyang chog go /bum pa rnams yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ nyes pa kun spangs shing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi gdan dang*/ dbang bum gyi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i gdan rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /hūṃ las dbus kyi shar du thams cad rig pa sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ zhes pa nas/ rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol byang shar mtshams nas brtsams te/ hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ dung chos 'dzin pa/ de dag gi phyi rol shar du nas/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyed/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs kyi mthar/ puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod kyi sngags tsam kho nas 'bul/ chos dbyings ye shes mkha' ltar khyab pa las/ / thugs rje chen pos rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /sbyang dka' 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces brjod/ 'di dag cho ga bsdud pa'i lugs yin pas rgyas btab mi dgos/

oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsha sogs kyis dbang bskur/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byed na bshad ma thag pa bzhin dang*/ /rgyas pa byed na rten cing 'brel 'byung ma lta bu'i tshigs bcad dang sbyar zhing*/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs sho lo ka lnga tsam gyi bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la brten nas bum nang du song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bar gyur/ rnam rgyal la dmigs nas/ lha thams cad kyi sngags bzla ste/ rtsa rig dang gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi gsum gsum sogs so/ / dbang bum la dmigs nas rtsa rig dang rigs lnga'i sngags/ mchod bum la dmigs nas rtsa rig bzla/ mdor bsdu na thams cad la rtsa rig kho na bzlas pas kyang chog go /mthar a bhi ṣi ka 'i sngags kyang bzlas gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas/ bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ dung chos kyi chu phul/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis brtan byed bya'o/ /spyir rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi bum pa la/ /lha bskyed mi dgos pa'ang yod mod kyi/ / lha bskyed phyin sa bon las bskyed na legs pas de bzhin du sbyar la/ ci ste skad cig gis bskyed par 'dod na/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ dbang bskur rnams mi dgos so/ /bum bskyed mdo tsam bshad zin to/ /gsum pa mdun bskyed kyi cho ga ni/ spros pa la dga' na/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ til sbyang dang*/ khrus gsol sogs kyang bya/ /'on kyang nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra

nas/ zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nang rim pa gnyis yod pa/ phyi la lha sna ma rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug gis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'ang nang nas rim pa bzhin zhes so/ / dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo nas/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir sbyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi/ zhes pa nas/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ gzhan yang dam tshig la yang dag par gnas shing*/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' 'bangs su gyur pa ji snyed pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur zhing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur ba'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnams sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ / dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ / kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/

/tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho bha ga wān/ e h+ye hi/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka dri sh+ya hoḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma yi hūṃ/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shre ye hūṃ/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchog pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+wa ཾ / /zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa rnams/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ / phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /sims byed yid 'ong ldan pa ni/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ni/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin che mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod la/

/thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig ces sogs kyang bya/ sngags dang phyag rgya byas te phul na yang legs so/ / oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ sogs bsgo ba bzhis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas te nang du bkug /las dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa nas/ tu ṣad+ya ho 'i srung ba byas/ mgron thabs kyi lha rnams gdan la 'khod par gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i snam bu dang po la skal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug 'khod de/ shar du byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa/ lhor spos kyi glong po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog rnams rdo rje rin chen dang mtshungs pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od bzang skyong*/ dra ba can gyi 'od rnams rdo rje chos dang mtshungs pa/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ lhag ma rdo rje las dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lha snam bar pa la nyan thos chen po bcu drug ni/ dga' bo sgra gcan 'dzin dang mchog gnyis so/ /rab 'byor 'char ka ma 'gags kun shes dang*// nye 'khor rta dul kun dga' ba lang bdag /ming chen nor 'dzin gang po 'od srungs so/ /lha snam gsum pa la/ sgo'i thad ka bor ba'i gzhan rnams su/ gdung sel snang ba brtsegs dang 'jigs pa med/ /dpa' 'dul shes rab mgyogs chen ri bo'i rgyal/ /smra ba'i sgra gcan bse ru dug sel 'joms/ /rdzu 'phul cher ston yid 'gyur seng ge'i sgra/ zhes te nyan rangagi mtshan ngos 'dzin 'di rnams rgya gar paṇa chung dang bod rnying pa la yid brtan bcas pa tsam mo/ / sgo'i thad ka'i lha snam la shar du khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/

lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'chang*/ byang du 'jig rten gsum 'jig de bzhi rtsa phyag gis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can no/ /de dag gi g.yas phyogs su pho nya bzhi rim pas dbyug sngon can/ /mi g.yo ba/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ rta mgrin rnams so/ /mngags pa bzhi ni khro bo rnams kyi g.yon phyaugs su dus kyi srin po/ dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ dus kyi mtshan ma/ dus kyi gnod sbyin ma'o/ /bran bzhi ni khro bo rnams kyi rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ dus kyi zhags pa ma/ dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ dus kyi dril bu ma rnams so/ /de rnams las ming gis gsal ba rnams rang ming gi phyag mtshan g.yas dang por yod pa/ yongs ye thams cad kyang sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ma nges pa/ dbu phyag mtha' yas pa/ ma rungs pa'i rgyu ma 'dren zhing gdug pa can thams cad kyi snying ga nas zhabs kyis mnan zhing sdigs par mdzad pa/ khro bo pho mo'i cha byas yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ khyams kyi phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug ser po la 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams 'khod pa ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du

zhes pa nas/ dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gongabazhin brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'dir phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab mi byed na/ skabs 'dir oṃ bh+ri ta sogs kyis gnas gsum byin rlabs bya ste/ rgya bzhi yis lcogs na rung tsam ni yin no/ /'on kyang rgyas btab byed pa nyid bzang bas/ cho ga gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /skal bzang gi sems dpa' man chad la byed na/ sems dpa' la sde tshan gcig /nyan thos la sde tshan gcig /rang rgyal sde tshan gcig /khro bo sogs la sde tshan gcig /'jig rten pa rnams la sde tshan gcig byed de/ dam rgya'i skabs dmigs bsal gyi skabs med pas/ rtsa rig lan gsum gsum brjod nas*/ spyi'i dam rgya 'cha' ba sogs gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs 'gre ba yin no/ /'on kyang mgron du byon pa yin gyi/ rtsa ba'i lha ma yin zhing*/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa med pas/ de dag la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab ni mi dgos so/ /de lta mod kyi las bcol gyi skabs su/ de rnams la'ang las 'tshol dgos pas des na 'di ltar bya ste/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sarba bid nas/ sgo ma bzhis kyang zhes nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin de rjes su rtsa rig tshar gcig gam/ bzhi 'am bcu drug ston te/ byams pa la sogs pa skal ba bzang po'i sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang = rtsa rig de dang 'dra/ 'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos dgra bcom chen po bcu drug gis kyang = rtsa rig gcig gam bzhi'am bcu gnyis/ gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa 'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis kyis kyang*/ yang rtsa rig gcig gam bzhi'am bcu drug khro bo bzhi pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi po dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang = de rnams kyi skabs spros pa la dga' na/ bskyed chog gi skabs bzhin so so'i mtshan nas smos te bya'o/ /yang rtsa rig lan gzhi'am brgyad dam/ bsdu na gcig bzlas te/

dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' 'khor du gnas pa'i sde brgyad mthu chen thams cad kyis kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la 'jug pa la gnas skabs kun tu bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ yid la 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ dge legs rgya chen po sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las gzhol/ bzhi pa mchod gtor ni/ de nas mchod pa rgya cher bshams shing*/ gong gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin la/ gnas khang gi bskyed chog bor bas byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang*/ /bdag gi gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pratīts+tsha pu dza meghā sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ shab+ta 'i bar du rigs bsgres nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te 'bul/ de nas mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/ dpag yas bsod nams stobs la byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas las grub rin chen cod pan mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes bzhes shig dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭi pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hū ཾ / gzhan thams cad de kho na ltar sbyor la/ /tshig rkang gnyis pa lha rdzas las grub sogs dang*/ sngags kyi rat+na mu ku ṭaṃ gi gnas su/ so so'i tshig dang ming sngags bcug ste/ rim bzhin sbyar ro/ /de yang*/ snyan shal mdzes byed rin chen 'khyil ba'i rgyan/ kun+ṭa la= mgrin pa dung 'dra mdzes byed mgul rgyan mchog har+ṣa = thugs ka'i dpa' be'u mdzes byed sai mo do/ a wa hā ra= phyag gi dpung pa mdzes byed dpung rgyan mchog /ke yu ra= phyag gdub nor bu'i phra rgyan mdzes pa 'di/

swa ti ka ṭa kaṃ= yid 'ong sor gdub la sogs sna tshogs rgyan/ pa kaṃ ba la= rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyi rgyan gyur rkang gdub 'di/ nū phu+u ra= rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ ts+tsha traṃ ka= mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog dh+wa dza= snyan grags phyogs bcur g.yo ba ba dan phan/ pa taṃ ga= yid 'phrog sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi ni/ pa ṭa dā ma= gdung sel rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ tsa ma raḥ mkha' dbyings mdzes par byed pa'i bla re 'di/ pi tā naṃ = mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa'i seng ge'i khri/ sidhā sa na= reg 'jam mi bde spangs pa gzims cha'i tshogs/ 'di la snga ma rnams sha ya ā sa na/ sha ya sarba na zer yang skad dod rdo bcal bsgrigs bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ / des na/ par+yaṃ ga zhes bya'o/ / nyon mongs zur spangs khang bzang zlum po 'di/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa la dhā n+yaṃ= rgyas pa'i khang bzang dam pa gru bzhi pa/ a me ya tsa tu rā praṃ/ khyad 'phags gtso bo'i khang bzang nyis brtsegs 'di/ dwi ku ṭa ga ra= rang bzhin 'od gsal byang sems zla ba'i gdan/ tsan+ḍā sa naṃ= 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos me tog tshogs/ puṣ+paṃ= sna tshogs rten 'brel pi waṃ sgra snyan tshogs/ bī nāṃ= rab tu dang ba bskyed byed tshul khrims dri/ gan+dhaṃ= dga' dang shin tu sbyangs pa'i zhal zas mchog /nai bi te= ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos/ ba s+t+raṃ= 'di dag gi sngags dang phyag rgya gang zag gis sbyar ba'i glo bur ba yin kyang*/ mchod pa'i ngo bo rnams rgyud 'dir sngon byung lo rgyus kyi tshul du ston pa la mchod pa'i skabs byung ba yin pas/ 'grel zhing legs pa'ang yin no//de nas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ zhes sogs gong bzhin lha mo brgyad/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ sogs/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dang*/ gos zung 'bul tshul spyi dang mtshungs pas/

lha re re bzhin gos zung 'bul ba yang spro na bya'o gzhan yang mchod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ nyer gcig pa dang*/ rig ma bcu drug pa la sogs pa'ang bya mod kyi/ ha cang spros pa ches pa rang mi legs pas mtshams par bya'o/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la'o/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad spyod mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la'o/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ /sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag/gsung rab pad+ma kha rgyas pa/ khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po/ shākya rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las bdag/sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus pa ni zhi mdzad pa/ /me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang*/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma kī/ /dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ / rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdzu 'phul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /rgyud bzhi bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ / rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ / rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*/ /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /nges pa'i rgyal po rdo rje mchog / phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ / rdo rje legs pa'i sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dges rdo rje rgyal po mchog

/phyag 'tshal rdo rje dges khyod la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i nor bu che/ /nam mkha' snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od// rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la/ /sems can don rab rdo rje dpal/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdo rje chos rab de nyid don/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab dga' byed/ /'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje can/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la/ rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po*/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ / rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gsung rab ri rab mchog /rdo rje zlos pa rab grub sbyin/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog grub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje dka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab sgrol/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdo rje srung ba brtan pa che/ /rdo rje go cha sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ / rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab bsdus nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching ba rab sgrol byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/

/mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gying ba la/ /rnam dag yon tan rdo rje ste/ /yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong*/ /rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'phreng ba la/ /rnam dag rdo rje gsung mchog ma/ /rdo rje pi waṃ 'dzin pa'i tshul/ / rdo rje gsung mchog sgrogs pa'i don/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la/ / rnam dag rdo rje las rab ste/ /las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad/ /bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan la/ /sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma/ /tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pas/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje bdug pa la/ /rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs 'dzin zhing*/ /rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul/ /byang chub yan lag me tog ste/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la/ /'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /rdo rje spyan gyis ma rig sel/ /gsal byed rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snang byed la/ /rdo rje tsan dan bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la/ /rnam dag bskul byed rdo rje'i don/ /rdo rje sdud mdzad rdo rje don/ /rdo rje 'gugs mdzad phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags kyu la/ /mi gtod rdo rje chos kyi don/ /rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don/ / 'chid mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la/ /rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin myur/ /sgrog mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /bskyod mdzad rdo rje kun kyi las/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/

/sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i/ /byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ ston pa'i rtag 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar sil po ti'i phyag /bslab sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel don la brtan gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ /'byung dang zlog la rab bzhugs pa/ /rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa/ /stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris pa/ /'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang*/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ bstod pa 'di ni da ltar thams cad la grags pas 'dir bkod do/ /'di'i sems dpa' bcu drug gi bstod pa ni/ de nyid bsdus pa la 'byung ba'i gtso bo'i mtshan brgya yin pas shin tu bzang shing gal che la/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi sgo skyong rnams pan+ṭi ta dran pa ye shes kyi brtsams par grags pa de'i nang gi tshig yin zhing*/ skal bzang man chad la bstod pa de ni re re bzhin sbyar ba'i rgyas pa zhig 'dug la/ bod kyi cho ga mkhan po rnying pa 'gas bsdus te 'di brtsams par snang ngo*/ /des na rgyal ba'i bka' dang*/ 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen pos mdzad pa rnams ma gtogs/ gsar du sbyar ba rnams la ji ltar 'os pa la nges pa can gyi rkang tshugs mi dgos so/ /de nas gtor ma btang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa nyid dam phyi rol du gtong yang rung ste gtor ma cha gsum/ rigs drug dang*/ yi dwags kyi gtor ma rnams mchod par bcas pa bshams/ cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ de rjes byin rlabs 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs dam pa la= sku 'byams klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa 'di/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig / yang de bzhin du kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyi bsngo ba yan chad 'dra ba las/ rigs drug gi zhes pa'i tshab tu yi dwags kyi 'gro ba thams cad la zhes pa bcug /de dag ni rigs drug dang yi dwags la gtor ma sbyin pa'o/ /'di dag phyi rol gtor ma tshul du byed na/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma song mtshams su/ rigs drug dang yi dwags kyi gtor ma sbyin/ de nas bgegs gtor btang*/ mtshams bcad ma thag nang du ldog pa lag len 'dug pa stabs bde ba'i phyir du snang mod/ de ltar yang rung ste/ 'jig rten pa rnams gtor mas mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /de dag gi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bstan zin to/ /lnga pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ de la dang por dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la/ sdoms na/ gsol btab rgyun bshags sems bskyed sdom bzung dang*/ byin rlabs gnyis dang smon lam chos bshad dang*/ /srung dang gdong g.yogs 'jug dang ye shes dbab/ /brtan byed me tog dor bcings mig dar dbye/ /lta bar bskul dang lha ngo bstan pa dang*/ /dam tshig bskyed dang brtan byed dam tshig bsgrags/ /sdom pa bsgrags pa zhes te nyer gnyis so/ /zhes blo la bzhag na/ don tshan sil bu rnams mi 'dzings par 'gyur ro/ /dngapo gsol btab ni/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyangabadag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag med bdag gis sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ sa ma ya a/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rdo rjes reg ste/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sid dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun sogs/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung tshar gsum/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ drug pa byin rlabs gnyis pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a dhe tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su reg go / snying ga lkog ma kha dang dpral ba dang*/ / mdzod spu rna ba 'tshogs ma spyi gtsug dang*/ /dpung pa sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna rtsa mig dang gsang ba'o/ / bdun pa ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ brgyad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/

/tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ / skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yi gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ / yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen tu/ /sad ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas ni/ /rang byung skal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ dgu pa bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba ni/ khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs lan gsum brjod/ bcu pa ni/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis mig dar bcings/ bcu gcig pa ni/ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya hūṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas zhugs/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus skabs 'dir yol ba bsal/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ a las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje'i dbus su as mtshan pa/ rang nyid hūṃ las gtso bo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje/ dpral bar trāṃ las rin chen/ lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma/ spyi bor kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ud gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i a yig las a yig dpag tu med par byung*/ /rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje'i lte bar thim/

'od zer gyis lus gang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūṃ yig gi rnam par char ltar babs/ bdag gi lus la thim/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūṃ/ mang du brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ bcu gsum pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ a sa me tri mahā sa ma ya hūṃ/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ oṃ pra ti grih+ṇa twaṃ/ zhes me tog dor/ bco lnga pa ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ me tog rang ngam slob ma'i mgo la bcing*/ bcu drug pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya ud gha ṭa ya hū ཾ / bcu bdun pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor la lta bar bskul/ bco brgyad pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur la skabs 'dir bdag bskyed ltar lha ngo rgyas par bstan no/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ snying gar rdo rje 'bar ba gnas par gyur/ lha rnams kyi dam tshig gis byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ nyi shu pa ni rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da ya me/ pra be sha dṛ ṭa ho tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ nyer gcig pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu'am rnam rgyal gyi chu nas cung zad 'thungs/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /ci ste dam tshig bzlas na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nas gshags/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang*/

/bdun brgyud rigs rnams brlag par byed/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsung pa'i dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa dang ni bla mas bka'/ /shin tu mos pas srung bar bya/ nyer gnyis pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*/ /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang*/ /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*/ /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang*/ /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// lha la phul ba'i rnying ma dang*/ /de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyis la sogs bya ba min/ mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ mdor na yid gnyis the tshom mi bya ste/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ / zhes te/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa bstan zin to/ /dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs te snying gar thim/ rje zlos byas par mos te rtsa rig lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ mgo thog tu rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid a/ /oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid swā/ oṃ sarba bid a/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/

oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ oṃ sha oṃ bha/ zhes brjod/ sngags dbang ngo*/ / oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣeñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhe ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma ka la sha abhi ṣiñtsa a/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'dis/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur na/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa kun dag ste/ /byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog / bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas mgo bar gtugs/ skabs su bab na dbu rgyan bcing ngo*/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog / rin chen 'phreng ba 'ching ngam/ rin po che'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon nas g.yas kyi bar la lan lnga bzhag / oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog 'phreng ba 'dis/ skal ldan= bsam pa myang 'das sbyor ba khams gsum gnas/ /mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cig dar dpyangs dngos sam/ rdo rje khur tshur las gung mdzub brkyang bas dar dpyangs 'ching tshul byed/ oṃ badz+ra paṭ+ṭa a wa laṃ bi na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ mdzes shing yid 'ong dar gyi cod pan 'dis/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog dar dpyangs kyi dbang ngo*/ /rdo rje'am rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lag tu blang ngo*/ / oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ

oṃ karma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa ྄a/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan= sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /ye shes lnga ni rab tu rtaugs par shog / phyag mtshan gyi dbang ngo*/ /phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i dril bu spyi bo sogs dbang gi gnas lngar dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhī ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshan ma ming gi dbang*/ /skal ldan= ma 'ongs 'jig rten sangs rgyas zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / ming dbang ngo*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan= 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mthar phyin nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo*/ /'khor lo bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ bh+rūṃ/ yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis/ /skal ldan= rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor bar shog / chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbang ngo*/ / 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rin chen= oṃ rat+na tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ pad+ma'i= oṃ pad+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ las kyi= oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa a a a/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis/

skal ldan= rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun kyi bdag por shog / bdag po'i dbang ngo*/ /yum lnga'i phyag mtshan spyi bo sogs gnas lngar gtugs pa'am/ lag tu bzung nas/ oṃ bud+dha dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ yum lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan= gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas kyang*/ / 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog / gzungs kyi dbang ngo*/ /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar reg cing*/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhi ṣañtsi trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar gtugs nas ni/ /skal ldan= ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs 'gyur pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang*/ /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ de kho na nyid bcu la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las mtha' dag bsgrub par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ / de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin/ khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so/ / rdor dril bsnol te bzung*/ oṃ pra dzñā ud pa ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ a/ thabs shes sbyor ba'i dbang ngo*/ / oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /mi khom rgyun gcod rgyu dang 'bras bu ston/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug rin po che/ /bla med 'khor lo dam pa bskor gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/
