dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan rin po che/ / 'khor ba'i mun sel bde ba'i snying po 'byung*/ /dgos pa mchog sbyin nor bdun phun sum tshogs/ /yid bzhi nor bu rin chen spyod par shog /oṃ bā sti ni rah+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ pha rol phyin bcus sems can skyod pa'i phyir/ /shes rab gzugs 'dzin btsun mo rin po che/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi tshad med bzhi po yis/ /tshe dang longs spyod gter la spyod par shog /oṃ mahā sti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ gang la ci dgos dpag bsam shing lta bu/ /'gro la snying brtses tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ /dbang phyug btsun pa blon po rin po che/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs thob par shog oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ theg pa don dam bla med ston pa'i mchog /yan lag bdun mdzes ku mu ta yi mchog /gdul dka' stobs chen glang po rin po che/ khyu mchog rlabs chen stobs lnga rdzogs par shog /oṃ tu rāṃ ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ 'khor ba'i chu bo 'jigs pa bzhi las sgrol/ /brtson 'grus myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis bskyod/ /cang shes sprin kyi shugs can rin po che/ /mi gnas ye shes yid bzhin spyod par shog

/oṃ khaṅga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ gnod pa'i dpung 'joms brtson 'grus go bgos shing*/ /'jigs pa'i skyabs byed 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dmag dpon ni/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phyul dpung gis bsrung bar shog / ces pa rnams spros pa la dga' na bya/ yang na sngags bdun gyi mthar/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin chen sna bdun ni/ skal ldan= byang chub yan lag rin chen bdun thob nas/ / rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gco bor shog / ces pa tsam brjod na'ang legs te/ rin chen bdun kar sdoms pa dbang gcig kho na yin pas/ snga ma rnams dang rgyas bsdus mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i phan yon yod do/ /bum pa'i dbang nas brtsams te/ /'di'i bar gyi smon lam gyi tshigs bcad rnams spros pa la dga' ba'i don zhi khro 'dra dpe blangs pa rnying ma ba'i lugs su 'dug cing*/ gong ma rnams phal cher de dang de'i rjes su tshig lhug pa'i gyur shog re yang mdzad par 'dug ste/ blo chung rnams kyi blo gros gron du 'gyur ba'i phyir 'dir bkod pa tsam 'tsham la/ /spyir ni sngags dbang kho nas go chod cing*/ byin rlabs kyang de ngos che bar 'ong ngo*/ /rin chen bdun gyi dbang ngo*/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad byas shing kun zos kyang*/ /'grub 'gyur nyes pa'i mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pa smos ci dgos/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ā dzñā d+ya dā s+ya mi/ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra su sid+dhi ye/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ khyod kyis sems can gyi don rgya cher spyod cig bka'i dbang ngo*/ /de dag ni dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas rjes su gdams pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na/ /lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla mar mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni// rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur bas/

/slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang*/ rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya/ /rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnon byed na/ / bzod pa sgom par mi bya ste/ /bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*/ /dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang*/ /de sogs byed pa tshar bcad na/ /'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung*/ /sems can kun la snying rjes chags/ /bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes so/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams ta sogs brjod/ spro na/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ zhes sogs dam tshig gsum gyi glu yang blangs/ de rjes/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rigs lnga dang rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo gcig par mos/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra/ rat+na dha ra pad+ma dha ra/ bi shwa dha ra sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ti/ ta thā ga ta dha ra sa ma yo ra haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags lan mang du brjod cing rdor sems kyi nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o/ /'di slob ma dbang bskur ram/ gshin po'i sgrib sbyong gi bya ba la 'jug pa'i skabs su gtso bor bshad pa yin mod kyi/ /cho ga'i yan lag chad par mi 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang*/ dbang bskur blang zin pa'i 'bras bur yang snang ba'i phyir/ bdag 'jug gi 'jug tu yang nges par bya'o/ / bdag 'jug mi len na yang sgrub mchod kyi mthar 'di bsgom dgos la/ kha cig sngags dbang dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ srung ba gsum po'ang byed zer de/ nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ / slob ma la dbang bskur na'ang skabs 'dir byed cing*/ gshin po'i don du lho sgo'i bya ba rnams kyang skabs 'dir sgrub pa yin no/ /de nas rjes chog ni/ /mchod pa rnying pa yod na kha gso/ gsar pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ spyir dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang*/

khyad par du sngags rgyud kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje nyid lha thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje sems dpa' nyid der mos pa la/ mchod bstod byas par bsams la/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ/ gong sgrub mchod kyi skabs bzhin/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar = puṣ+pe= lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ / mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ ci bde ba= badz+ra dhu pe= mun pa'i sdug bsngal 'joms byed cing*/ /phyogs kun gsal byed mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes stsol bya'i phyir/ ci bde bar= badz+ra ā lo ke= sbyar las byung dang lhan cig skyes/ /dri zhim mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyi// kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ badz+ra gan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ / bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag / chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul= badz+ra nai bi te= bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston zhing*/ /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro ral mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'kho lo gzhoms phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don dam dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shab+ta = de rjes bstod pa 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma dang*/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas sogs/ phyag na rdo rje'i bstod pas bstod/ /rjes chog gi skabs 'dir mtshan brgyas stod na/ /sngon byung bya rgyud gsungs tshul dang mthun pas shin tu legs so/ / bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang ba dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

spro na gzhan yang gsol btab ji ltar 'os pa bya/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed kyi phyag rgya rnams dus gcig tu 'grol zhing*/ bum bskyed la'ang phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab na/ mnyam du 'grol/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gtso bo'i dam rgya bcas la/ rtsa rig gsum/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes se gol gtogs sngar bcings pa'i phyag rgya dkrol/ de bzhin du rtsa rig gi tshab tu oṃ sarba bid hūṃ sogs sbyar bas phyag rgya dkrol bar bya ste/ mthar sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ lan gsum badz+ra muḥ zhes se gol gtogs pas dkrol ba'i bar du'o/ /phyi rol gyi lha rnams la phyag rgyas ma btab pas dkraul rgyu med la/ lha gzhan rnams la'ang dam rgya dkrol ba nyid kyis phyag rgya thams cad dkrol ba yin pas phyag rgya gzhan rnams la mi dgos so/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs dpyad 'di la nyes byas gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang ba/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis rnams/ /gang yang de dag bzod par mdzod/ gzhan yang nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ji ltar 'os pa'ang spro na bya/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na de dang*/ gzhan yang rten rnying pa yod na brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad nas/ muḥ zhes pa lan gsum gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin na dkyil 'khor ba dang*/ gzhan yang bdag bskyed dang*/ bum pa'i ye shes pa dang*/ mgron gyi tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral= chos la=

sems can= de dag= tshogs mchod dam pa= dge 'dun= sems can= de dag= de la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing*/ dza ya dza ya zhes rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de dag gis ni thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa rtsa ba'i cho ga rnams bstan no/ /da ni tshe 'das kyi sdig pa sbyong ba phyir zlog gi cho ga bshad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ der mi byang sogs rten bzhag /brab rdzas bye ma dang yungs kar sogs la bzlas pa'i skabs su yang sngags kyis brabs/ sgos su yang sngags mang du bzla sbyang chas sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ bgegs bskrad rten bskyed rnam shes dgug /sdig pa dral zhing sngags kyis brab/ khrus bya dug sbyang skyabs 'gro dang*/ / dbang bskur rdzas gtang phung po sbyang*/ /lam sbyang lam bstan mchod 'bul dang*/ /ched brjod rang gnas spar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mtheb kyu bskor la/ oṃ sarba bugh+rān na maḥsarba sogs/ gsum gyis zhi bas sbyangs/ ting lo chad bur bcas pa bskor zhing*/ hūṃ/ bzhi pa gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mar sbyangs/ khro bo spyan 'dren nas/ dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar spro na drag rol dang bcas te yang bya/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba la las kyi dbang gis 'chi kha dang*/ bar do dang*/ tshe rabs gzhan thams cad du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*/ sdig pa sbyong zhing dge ba'i chos bskyed pa las bar du gcod par byed pa dang*/

'brel pa can shul na gnas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa la sogs pa/ gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod sems zhi zhing*/ dge ba'i sems dang ldan pas dmigs yul bsgrub bya 'di'i than 'khor du ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gal te mi 'gro na/ ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas pa bya'o/ / zhes gtor ma dor/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ /sbyang rten la phyogs bcur yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug stai drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rten de nyid yak+ṇa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge ṇiḥlas tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bya ba/ gson po'i dus kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ gsum pa ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ gong bzhin las bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bya ba/ khams gsum gang na gnas shing rigs drug gang du skyes sam/ skye gnas bzhi gang gi bsdus te 'dug kyang*/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas de'i sdig pa rnams kyang bkug par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ dral ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi spo ta sarba a pā ya ban+dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pā ya ga ti bh+yaḥsarba satwaṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ gsum/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ bi shodha ni huṃ phaṭa/ ces pas sdig pa sbyangs/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ sogs kyis ngan song sbyangs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha 'i sngags kyis gnas nyer gnyis byin rlabs gong du bshad pa bzhin byas/ rnam par shes pa a yig dkar por gyur/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pa ya bi sho dha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa ni bhasmi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ bh+rūṃ bi na sha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya a ba ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā ba ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba a ba ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ha ra a ba ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi dra ba bi dra ba sarba a pa ya/ ta ta to na ni huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tu na huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra te ka ga te he tu na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya k+ga te he tu na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams bzla zhing brab rdzas kyis brab/ drug pa ni/ lag len spros pa la dga' na/ dkyil 'khor la khrus gsol byas te de'i bum chus ming byang la khrus byed/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor la khrus gsol ma byas kyang chog /ming byang gi gzugs brnyan me long la shar ba la bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ / ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ sogs/ phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad re re'i mthar/ rtsa rig brjod cing bkru/ spro na/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas sogs kyang bya/ bdun pa ni/ bum chu nas sbyang rten la cung zad 'thor zhing*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ / de bzhin du/ dam chos bden pas = dge 'dun bden pas = sa 'di dug gi pha yin te/ /sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dus gsum sa yin nang du song*/ de bzhin du chu me rlung la'ang sbyar/ de nas spro na/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa sogs/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i shis brjod kyang mdzad pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog go /brgyad pa ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/

/'gro ba'i skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa che sel la/ /tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*/ /de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi/ /tshe 'das 'jigs pas rnam skrag ste/ /kun du bzang la bdag nyid 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyis/ /lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*/ /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ sdig ldan 'di la skyabs su gsol/ / 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ /skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ / 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ 'debs su gzhug /dgu pa ni/ gal te dbang mi bskur na/ skabs 'dir lam sbyang bstan byed la/ dbang bskur byed na'ang skabs 'di nyid du byed de/

dga' chen khyod bdag / sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa nas/ bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bdag 'jug gi skabs bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag sogs/ khyed kyi srog chags bsad mi bya/ sogs dang*/ bka'i dbang bskur man chad bor bas lhag ma sngar bzhin byas na'ang legs te/ ye shes dbab pa'i skabs rang gi zhes pa tshe 'das kyi zhes 'don pa bsgyur dgos pa sogs phra mo rnams rig pas dpyad de shes par bya'o/ /bcu pa ni/ zas gtad dang gos lham sogs gtod dgos na yang dbang bskur ba'i rjes 'dir byed de/ rten bsgrub byar mos pa la dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib dag sde rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa la mchod par bsam/ zas gos rnams yak+ṣa sa bsangs swābhā sa sbyangs/ na maḥsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon lnga'i tshigs bcad las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' ba des rtag tu tshim par shog / ces rkang pa phyi ma gnyis bsgyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa rū pa ka ma gu ṇa sogs sngags kyang bsgyur/ bcu gcig pa phung po sbyang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer byung*/ 'di zhes bya ba'i phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs par gyur/ rtsa rig lan gsum dang*/ /snying po lan gsum gyi me ngar zhugs sbar zhing*/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig /gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me spar ro/ /'byung ba bzhi'i bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me spar ro/ /dbang po drug gi bud shing la/ /sems dpa' drug gi= /yul rnams drug gi bud shing la/

/lha mo drug gi= /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba sku gsum me spar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don du 'byung bar shog ces brjod/ bcu gnyis pa lam sbyang ba ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyis lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ / rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /'phags pa'i lam 'dir 'gro bar shog oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+ne rat+na sam+bha we/ /rat+na kirni rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bcu gsum pa lam bstan pa ni/ pad+ma 'dab gyis ma gos ltar/ srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba/ bde ba can du skye bar shog / oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma sam+bha we mahā su kha ba te gats+tshan+tu swāhā/ bcu bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ der pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong*/ /gdams pa dang rje bstan thob/ de'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i mthu yin par shes nas rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs te slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la lan du mar bskor ba byas te/ / mchod pa nyer lnga la sogs pa mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod/ bstod pas kyang bstod par 'gyur/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sa ra sogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'don zhing rol mo bya/ bco lnga pa ched du brjod pa ni/ e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi/ /sems can lha gnas myur du skye/ /e ma shākya mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/

zhes ched du brjod par gyur/ bcu drug pa rang gnas su spar ba ni/ slar yang bsgrub bya de nyid bde ba can gyi zhing khams su song bar bsams la/ oṃ pad+me pad+me sogs brjod la rol mo dang bcas me tog dor/ skabs 'dir byang bu bsregs pa'i lag len yang yod mod kyi/ dkyus nyid legs par mngon no/ /de dag gis ni phyir bzlog gi cho ga rnams bstan zin to/ /cho ga yongs rdzogs 'di dag kyang bsnyan pa sngon du song bas byar rung gi /gzhan gyi ma yin na/ bsnyen pa ji ltar bya zhe na/ 'di la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang*/ /ras bris kyi bsnyen pa sogs kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni/ sgrub pa la bsnyen pa'i ming btags pa tsam yin la/ 'ga' zhig bdag bskyed rgyas pa sbyar ba'i sgrub mchod la/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa gtong ngo zer ba ni/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dbye ba ma rig pas bsnyen pa gang la zer ro ma shes shing da lta'i cho ga sgrigs sgrub mchod 'di rnams sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag tsam yin gyi/ bsnyen pa'i 'dra 'bag tu mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i cal col du 'dug la/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa la bsnyen pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba'ang cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud 'ga' la yod mod kyi/ de ni dbang bskur la sogs pa dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i don gyi gnas bzhu ba'i bsnyen pa yin la/ 'di ni cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud min zhing bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni nyung ngu res rung ste/ dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di'i zur 'debs su phyogs mthong tsam 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga ni/ shin tu blo dman don du ngag 'don bsgrigs/ /dge des mtha' yas 'gro ba srid mtsho las/ /legs par drangs te byang chub sar 'god shog/ //ces pa thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs dang mthun par bkral ba/ 'khor ba kun grol zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ gzhan mang pos nan tan du bskul ba las/
tā ra nā thas zhor byung du brjod pa'o// // dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol bzhugs/ -PAGE 274--PAGE 273--PAGE 215-
